question: Which of the following ministries was held by Dharmendra Pradhan before he became Cabinet Minister of Education, Skill Development and Entrepreneurship in July 2021 ?

options.text: Ministry of Information and Broadcasting and Sports
Ministry of Housing and Urban Development
Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas and Steel

solution:
The correct answer is the **__Ministry of Petroleum and Natural gas and Steel.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Dharmendra Pradhan has been the longest serving Minister for Petroleum and Natural Gas in the history of independent India.
 
• Joining as the Minister of State (In-charge) in 2014, he was later promoted to the Cabinet rank in 2017.
 
• Dharmendra Pradhan is the new Minister of Education. He was appointed as part of Prime Minister Narendra Modi's first cabinet reshuffle in the second term.
 
• Mr. Dharmendra Pradhan is also vested with the responsibility of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Anurag Singh Thakur** Union Minister of Information & Broadcasting and Youth Affairs & Sports.
 
• **Anurag Singh Thakur **is the Union Minister of Information & Broadcasting and Youth Affairs & Sports.
 
• He is a** 4th term Member of Parliament** (Lok Sabha/Lower House) from **Hamirpur, Himachal Pradesh**.
 
• **Pashupati Kumar Paras **is the minister of the Ministry of **Food Processing Industries**.
 
• **Hardeep Singh Puri **is the minister of the Ministry of **Housing and Urban Development**.
